candidates.claim: The OUTSIDE_IN permit entry at position 0 (fw-01:59) allows any source to reach SCADA server 10.10.10.21 in OT on tcp/22, and this entry is effective because it is bound inbound on the outside interface (fw-01:100) and precedes the deny entry.
candidates.remediation: Remove the OUTSIDE_IN permit for tcp/22 to 10.10.10.21 (fw-01:59) so that all Internet traffic into OT is denied.

candidates.claim: The effective OUTSIDE_IN permit for tcp/22 to OT host 10.10.10.21 (fw-01:59, bound inbound on the outside interface at fw-01:100) is traffic between OT and OUTSIDE that is not one of the approved cross-zone services A1 to A7.
candidates.remediation: Remove the OUTSIDE_IN permit for tcp/22 to 10.10.10.21 (fw-01:59) so that OUTSIDE reaches OT only through approved services.

candidates.claim: The baseline comparison lists the access-list OUTSIDE_IN entry at fw-01:59 as added relative to the approved baseline, and this deviation has not been reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added OUTSIDE_IN entry at fw-01:59 with the approved baseline and remove it unless it is formally approved.
